name: EMP Prep
description: Prepares library videos for tracker upload: full-resolution screenshots, dotted tags, BBCode description, and a private .torrent hashed from the file in place.
author: Cove Community

externalDependencies.name: FFmpeg
externalDependencies.description: Extracts full-resolution screenshot frames. Uses whichever binary Cove is configured with, falling back to PATH.

externalDependencies.name: FFprobe
externalDependencies.description: Optional. Fills in audio channel and sample-rate detail for the media-info block.
